subject: Re: Kickoff: bi-tempered loss - decision: conservative preset for v1
body:
Decision time, since Q3 OKRs lock June 26 and I need this settled in the narrative.

We ship v1 with the conservative preset (t1=0.8, t2=1.2) and document the sensitivity envelope from Yara's matrix. The auto-tuning heuristic moves to Q3 as its own OKR with Rafael's 3-week estimate as the sizing - I am not risking the mid-July LRB slot on it. The +4.8 point result at 40% noise is the headline; the preset still captures most of it (+3.9 in Yara's rerun).

Fumiko, please write the temperature-tuning guidance doc as the customer-facing companion.

Bao - flag today if you disagree, otherwise this is the plan of record. And push Corpus on those last two ingestion tickets; nothing else on our critical path is outside our control.

Ximena
